name: application-image-cropper
title: Image Cropper
description: A draggable crop frame over an image with a rule-of-thirds grid and corner handles, aspect-ratio presets, and a zoom slider.
useWhen: Users upload an image (avatar, cover photo, product photo) and need to crop it to a specific aspect ratio before saving.
Precise framing matters enough to warrant a rule-of-thirds grid and zoom control, not just a fixed auto-crop.
avoidWhen: The image is always used as-is with no user framing control — skip the cropper and just constrain display with `AspectRatio`.
You need a full raster editing surface (filters, brightness, drawing) — this component is crop/zoom-only, not a general image editor.
responsiveBehavior: The crop stage keeps a fixed aspect ratio container that scales with its parent width; the aspect-preset buttons and zoom slider stack in the same order below it at all widths.
accessibility: Each corner handle should be keyboard-resizable via arrow keys in a real implementation, in addition to pointer drag.
Aspect preset buttons use aria-pressed to indicate the active ratio, not color alone.
The zoom slider's thumb position is paired with min/max magnifying-glass icons so its direction is clear without reading a label.

variants.title: Crop frame
variants.description: A square crop frame with a rule-of-thirds grid, four corner handles, a darkened mask outside the frame, aspect-ratio presets (1:1 active), and a zoom slider.
accessibility: The active aspect-ratio preset carries aria-pressed="true".

variants.title: Crop frame (Dark)
variants.description: Image cropper adapted for dark surfaces, including the crop-frame handles and mask opacity.
accessibility: Handles, grid lines, and controls all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
